inputs.locator: Decision feature: annualized RMS of complete weekly DTWEXBGS log changes. Primary uses the latest 13 complete weeks; rejection-only neighbors use 8 and 26 weeks. Each completed week-ending Friday becomes usable five calendar days later at 00:00 UTC. Compare current volatility strictly above the median of the prior 52 available same-lookback volatility values excluding current.

Frozen policy and accounting: hold 100 percent BTC when dollar volatility is at or below its lagged median and 50 percent BTC plus 50 percent zero-yield cash when above it; rebalance only on a state change at the next H1 open. Design is 2020-2022, historical Validation 2023-2024 and fair-reset annual folds 2020-2024. Normal cost is 10 bps fee plus 5 bps adverse slippage each side and stress cost is 20 plus 10 bps.

Frozen all-pass gates: positive normal and stress returns; Design drawdown at most 95 percent of buy-and-hold, upside capture at least 70 percent and Calmar at least buy-and-hold; Validation drawdown at most 90 percent, upside capture at least 70 percent, Calmar at least buy-and-hold, both regimes at least 60 days, 2 to 250 regime-change trades and stress drawdown at most normal plus 3pp; both neighbors positive with non-worse drawdown, at least 85 percent Calmar and 65 percent upside capture; annual positive breadth 4/5, drawdown breadth 4/5, Calmar breadth 3/5, upside breadth 4/5, top-year and top-positive-realized-slice contribution at most 60 percent, P90 and terminal holding at most 17520 hours and terminal liquidation cost at most 1pp.

objective: Evaluate exactly one frozen broad-dollar volatility BTC passive-core risk overlay on sealed pre-2025 DTWEXBGS and H1 corpora. Compare the 13-week primary with rejection-only 8-week and 26-week lookbacks against full-capital buy-and-hold under identical normal and stress costs. Freeze a historical candidate only if every Design, Validation, annual breadth, concentration, holding, terminal and neighbor gate passes; otherwise permanently close the exact family without tuning. This is historical development evidence, not OOS or Trading authorization.
